facts.fact: Kale 从餐厅后门溜出、脱下借来的围裙，回车里等她出来。
facts.anchor: Creeping out the rear entrance of the restaurant and dropping the borrowed apron, I make my way back to my car, waiting for her to exit.

facts.fact: 他要跟上她、拿到那张纸条、证实自己的怀疑。
facts.anchor: I need to follow her. Get that piece of paper. Confirm my suspicions.

facts.fact: 他断定她要用肉桂下毒，这也解释了她化名的由来。
facts.anchor: She’s going to poison them with cinnamon. It has to be that… That must be why she gives that name as her pseudonym too.

facts.fact: 跟车途中她险象环生：躲过四次事故、逆行掉头去买汉堡、倒车差点撞上他的车。
facts.anchor: After watching her barely avoid four accidents, whip a U-Turn in oncoming traffic to get to a burger joint, and then almost back into my car as she pulled out of a parking space, I am more than ready to give up.

facts.fact: 她拐进的竟是他住的小区，他恐慌加剧。
facts.anchor: And that feeling intensifies when she turns directly into my apartment complex.

facts.fact: 他一度以为身份早已暴露、她知道建站的人是谁。
facts.anchor: There is a single beat of crippling anxiety that I have somehow given myself away long before this. That she actually knows who set up her website. That she knows who I am.

facts.fact: 吼她的人是 Kale 的对门邻居 Bran。
facts.anchor: Bran lives across the hall from me, one of the unlucky neighbors that’s always fighting.

facts.fact: 他震惊：她也住在这栋楼？！
定位一直弹回他这里的原因至此解开——她就在附近。
facts.anchor: It’s why the data tracked her location to me. Because she was so nearby.

facts.fact: 一个计划在他脑中成形。
facts.anchor: A plan solidifies into my mind.

facts.fact: 那是实施复仇、改写自己未来的办法——而且不用亲自动手。
facts.anchor: A way to enact my revenge. To change the outcome of my future. Without ever getting my hands dirty…
I am exiting my car before I can think anything else through.
